explanation: Son of Joram and Athaliah, and king of Judah. He reigned for one year and ruled wickedly.
Daughter of Omri, mother to Ahaziah and queen of Judah. She killed her own grandchildren to keep power.
A righteous woman and daughter of King Joram, she rescued Joash from Athaliah's massacre and hid him in the temple.
Grandson of Athaliah, saved by Jehosheba and later became king of Judah after Athaliah's death.
Religious leaders who served God and the people by performing ceremonies and upholding God's law.
Members of the tribe of Levi, they had special religious duties and responsibilities in the temple and in service to God.
A holy place where people came to worship God, offer sacrifices, and pray. It was the center of Jewish faith and culture.
A sacred chest that contained the stone tablets with the Ten Commandments; it symbolized God's presence and covenant with Israel.
